comparison.objective: Commission a damper versus denest two rigid trays and park them in separate bays.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine tool alignment, collar tuning, and torque-limited locking versus tab grasping, clearance lifting, lateral transport, and precise placement.
comparison.success_condition: Two non-bottoming stops with retained setting versus both trays released, upright, stable, separated, and within bay pose tolerances.
comparison.reason: Rigid-body manipulation is the only broad commonality; denesting and parking do not test adjustment, locking, or dynamic response.
